pairs: It is certainly not tiresome for me to write the same things to you,
beware of those who work evil;
beware of those who are divisive.
we who serve God in the Spirit
and who glory in Christ Jesus,
et non in carne fiduciam habentes,
having no confidence in the flesh.
I might have confidence also in the flesh,
Si quis alius videtur confidere in carne,
for if anyone else seems to have confidence in the flesh,
For I was circumcised on the eighth day,
According to the law, I was a Pharisee;
I persecuted the Church of God;
according to the justice that is in the law,
But the things which had been to my gain,
hæc arbitratus sum propter Christum detrimenta.
the same have I considered a loss, for the sake of Christ.
Verumtamen existimo omnia detrimentum esse propter eminentem scientiam Jesu Christi Domini mei:
Yet truly, I consider everything to be a loss, because of the preeminent knowledge of Jesus Christ,
my Lord, for whose sake I have suffered the loss of everything,
considering it all to be like dung,
so that I may gain Christ,
et inveniar in illo non habens meam justitiam,
and so that you may be found in him, not having my justice,
sed illam, quæ ex fide est Christi Jesu:
but that which is of the faith of Christ Jesus,
quæ ex Deo est justitia in fide,
the justice within faith, which is of God.
and the power of his resurrection,
and the fellowship of his Passion,
having been fashioned according to his death,
si quo modo occurram ad resurrectionem, quæ est ex mortuis:
if, by some means, I might attain to the resurrection which is from the dead.
It is not as though I have already received this,
so that by some means I might attain,
et comprehensus sum a Christo Jesu.
that in which I have already been attained by Christ Jesus.
I do not consider that I have already attained this.
ad ea vero quæ sunt priora,
forgetting those things that are behind,
and extending myself toward those things that are ahead,
ad bravium supernæ vocationis Dei in Christo Jesu.
the prize of the heavenly calling of God in Christ Jesus.
Therefore, as many of us as are being perfected,
And if in anything you disagree,
God will reveal this to you also.
Verumtamen ad quod pervenimus ut idem sapiamus,
Yet truly, whatever point we reach, let us be of the same mind,
and let us remain in the same rule.
et observate eos qui ita ambulant,
and observe those who are walking similarly,
just as you have seen by our example.
quos sæpe dicebam vobis (nunc autem et flens dico) inimicos crucis Christi:
about whom I have often told you (and now tell you, weeping,) are walking as enemies of the cross of Christ.
and their glory is in their shame:
for they are immersed in earthly things.
Nostra autem conversatio in cælis est: unde etiam Salvatorem exspectamus Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum,
But our way of life is in heaven. And from heaven, too, we await the Savior, our Lord Jesus Christ,
who will transform the body of our lowliness,
according to the form of the body of his glory,
secundum operationem, qua etiam possit subjicere sibi omnia.
by means of that power by which he is even able to subject all things to himself.
